title: Patch PostgreSQL and enforce least-privilege roles
summary: Updates PostgreSQL to the patched build, revokes SUPERUSER from the application role, and restricts pg_hba.conf to the application subnet so the privilege-escalation path on db-prod-01 is closed.
script:
---
- name: Remediate CVE-2024-0005 on db-prod-01
  hosts: db-prod-01
  become: true
  tasks:
    - name: Update PostgreSQL to the patched package
      ansible.builtin.apt:
        name: postgresql-14
        state: latest
        update_cache: true

    - name: Revoke SUPERUSER from the application role
      community.postgresql.postgresql_user:
        name: app_service
        role_attr_flags: NOSUPERUSER,NOCREATEDB

    - name: Restrict pg_hba.conf to the application subnet
      ansible.builtin.copy:
        dest: /etc/postgresql/14/main/pg_hba.conf
        content: |
          # Managed by Drishti remediation - review before applying
          local   all   all                    peer
          host    all   app_service  10.0.2.0/24  scram-sha-256
        owner: postgres
        group: postgres
        mode: '0640'
      notify: reload postgresql

  handlers:
    - name: reload postgresql
      ansible.builtin.service:
        name: postgresql
        state: reloaded
steps: Update postgresql-14 to the patched version
Revoke SUPERUSER from the application role
Restrict pg_hba.conf to the app subnet (10.0.2.0/24)
Reload PostgreSQL to apply the new host-based access rules
